北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 14℃ 凉意渐浓，注意保暖别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 14℃. It's getting cooler, so dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 15℃ 略有凉意，记得添衣，小心湿冷感冒。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Cixi, feels like 15℃ with a slight chill. Remember to add layers, and watch out for damp cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全，小心慢行哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Shanghai, visibility is low. Please pay attention to traffic safety and drive slowly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州有雨，湿度 95% 潮湿闷热，出门记得带伞，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Rainy in Guangzhou, 95% humidity makes it damp and stuffy. Remember your umbrella and stay dry!
广州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 27℃ 湿度大，注意补水，保持清爽。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenzhen, 27℃ with high humidity. Stay hydrated and keep cool.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 19℃ 湿度大，出门带伞，防止细雨绵绵。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Hangzhou, feels like 19℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella for potential drizzle.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 16℃ 伴随西风，小心风寒，多穿一点哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Nanjing, feels like 16℃ with westerly winds. Watch out for wind chill and dress warmly.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 18℃ 湿度高，空气湿润，体感舒适。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chengdu, 18℃ with high humidity. The air is moist, and it feels comfortable.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 19℃ 略有凉意，昼夜温差大，记得添衣。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Wuhan, feels like 19℃ with a slight chill. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, add layers.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 18℃ 干燥，注意补水，润润嗓子。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 18℃ and dry. Remember to hydrate and soothe your throat.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 21℃ 湿度适中，出行不必担心，轻松愉快。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chongqing, 21℃ with moderate humidity. No worries for your outing, enjoy!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 9℃，记得裹紧外套，多喝热水，暖暖身体！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: It feels like 9℃ in Harbin, remember to bundle up, drink more hot water to keep warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 10℃，风吹有些凉，多穿点，注意防寒保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: It feels like 10℃ in Shenyang, a bit chilly with the wind. Dress warmly and stay protected from the cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明下雨，体感 7℃ 湿冷，务必带伞，注意保暖防着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Rainy in Kunming, feels damp and cold at 7℃. Be sure to bring an umbrella and dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，气温 28℃ 闷热，注意防暑，多喝水哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Xiamen, 28℃ and muggy. Watch out for heatstroke and drink plenty of water.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大风 5级，体感只有 5℃，出门务必加厚防风，别冻着！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Strong winds (level 5) in Qingdao, feels like only 5℃. Be sure to wear thick, windproof clothes when going out!
青岛.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 5℃ 伴有凉风，多穿点，小心受寒，保护好自己。
大连.ai_briefing_en: It feels like 5℃ with a cool breeze in Dalian. Dress warmly, watch out for the cold, and take care.
